request: Review correctness of the documented verification command, limited to whether it preserves the fixture files. Return the structured review record.

artifacts.text: Run `python verify.py --out fixtures`. Verification must preserve all fixture bytes, including when a mismatch is detected. The command checks existing files and never regenerates them.

import argparse
from pathlib import Path


def check(out):
    actual = (out / "expected.txt").read_text()
    expected = "stable\n"
    (out / "expected.txt").write_text(expected)
    return actual == expected


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--out", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    raise SystemExit(0 if check(args.out) else 1)
